title: fix(console): one neutral sentence for an object you cannot open on every object route, and a translated filter empty state
body:

Fixes #34740

Clause-②: no
Metadata-protocol: none

## 维护者速读

- 改了什么：控制台四条对象路由（列表、data、记录、新建）在对象打不开时统一显示同一句中性文案「对象"X"不存在，或者您无权访问它。」，11 种语言一致；列表筛选器空选项不再写死英文「No options」，改读语言包（中文「暂无可选项」）。
- 为什么改：服务端对无读权限的对象和不存在的名字回答完全一样（裁决 6787890900），但控制台原句断言「不存在」，而且分散在两个 key 上；中文界面里还漏着英文筛选空态。
- 风险与回滚：只改文案与 key 指向，退役 `empty.objectNotFoundDescription`（无其他调用方）；`packageDisabled` 分支与列表提示不变。回滚即 revert 本 PR。
- 先看：`ui/packages/app-shell/src/views/RecordFormPage.tsx`（新建页改 key 并加 testid）、`ui/packages/i18n/src/locales/en.ts`（改写一句、删一句）、`ui/packages/plugin-list/src/UserFilters.tsx`（空态走 `tt()`）。
- 两分钟验证：`pnpm --dir ui exec vitest run packages/app-shell/src/views/objectRouteAbsence-34740.test.tsx packages/plugin-list/src/__tests__/UserFilters.emptyOptionsLocale-34740.test.tsx`，预期全部通过（8 + 5 个用例）。
- 需要你做的：无，席位落地。

## What changes

**One key for all four object routes (ruling A of the claim amendment).** I pointed the record and create faces at the single key, and did not reword both keys:

- `RecordDetailView` and `RecordFormPage` now draw `console.objectView.objectNotFoundDescription` (param `objectName`). That is the key the list face (`ObjectNotFoundState`) and the data face (`ObjectDataPage`) already drew.
- The key is reworded, in all 11 packs, to a sentence that neither asserts nor reveals existence. en: `The object "NAME" does not exist, or you do not have access to it.` zh-Hans: `对象"NAME"不存在，或者您无权访问它。` zh-Hant is regenerated by `gen:zh-hant`.
- `empty.objectNotFoundDescription` is retired from all 11 packs. It has no other caller.
- The en eager pack changes by -136 raw bytes (one line deleted, one value +4 chars).
- The `packageDisabled` arm, the list hint and both title keys are unchanged.
- `ObjectDataPage` and `RecordFormPage` gain `data-testid="object-not-found"` on that face, the testid the other two faces already carry.

**Filter empty state.** The popover for a chip whose field has no options now reads `tt('fields.options.empty', 'No options available')`. This is an existing eager key that all 11 locales carry (zh-Hans 暂无可选项). Its meaning is "this field has no options", which `lookup.noOptions` does not match: that key is the search-miss wording. The empty state gains `data-testid="filter-options-empty-FIELD"`.

## Tests

- New `ui/packages/app-shell/src/views/objectRouteAbsence-34740.test.tsx` covers the list, data and create routes in en and zh-CN. Each case renders a withheld object (`crm_lead`, absent from a served list that holds a readable sibling) and a missing name, and checks that both read the pack sentence and are byte-identical once the name is removed. It also has a premise cell that pins the wording and checks the retired key is absent.
- New block `RecordDetailView.objectRouteAbsence-34740` in `RecordDetailView.harness.test.tsx` covers the record route, en and zh-CN.
- New `UserFilters.emptyOptionsLocale-34740.test.tsx` covers en, zh-CN, the no-provider fallback, and a control with options.
- Updated tests:
  - `NotFoundState.test.tsx`: the new en sentence.
  - `user-filter-arity-spec-parity.test.tsx`: its two absence checks now use the new testid. The old text query would have passed vacuously.
  - `de-quote-pairing-3876.test.ts`: fixed keys 20 to 19, spans 22 to 21, paired spans and the count identity 119 to 118, each with a history line.
  - `residue-namespaces-3546.test.tsx`: dropped the three style pins on the retired key. Its sibling `empty.interfacePageSourceMissing` keeps the same pins.

<details><summary>Ablations (each mutation proven on disk by scripts/ablation-replace.mjs, each restore proven by blob == HEAD and an empty git diff HEAD)</summary>

- Record face put back on `empty.objectNotFoundDescription`: the harness block shows 2 failed. Both cells were RED.
- Create face put back: `objectRouteAbsence-34740` shows 2 failed / 6 passed (both create cells RED).
- en sentence put back to "does not exist in the current configuration": 1 failed / 7 passed. Only the premise cell went RED. The route cells read the sentence from the pack, so they follow it, and the test header now says so.
- Filter literal put back (`{'No options'}`): 3 failed / 2 passed. The en, zh-CN and no-provider cells were RED; the control stayed green. The first attempt used the replacement text `No options`, which is a substring of the new fallback. The tool refused it (count 3 to 3) and that run was void.

</details>

- app-shell, narrowed (declared): 25 files that render the four faces or name the keys or testid, 271 tests passed. I stopped the full-package run at 43 minutes on the shared box. CI's Test UI runs it in full.
- `pnpm --dir ui exec vitest run scripts/`: 171 files passed / 2 skipped, 5077 tests passed.
- type-check exit 0 with 0 TS errors for `@object-ui/app-shell`, `@object-ui/plugin-list` and `@object-ui/i18n`.

</details>

## Acceptance notes

- The record and create faces now show one sentence. The old second sentence ("Check your configuration or navigate back…") is gone. Both faces keep their Back button. The list face keeps its own hint.
- `de-quote-pairing-3876.test.ts` pins de-pack span counts (now 118). Open PRs that share the locale files merge cleanly with this one (overlap-check). A sibling that adds or removes a German quoted span moves that number, and whichever lands second rebases it.
- Eager closure: the gzipped `i18n-locale-en` reading is NOT MEASURED locally, because it needs the Console build that Build & E2E UI runs. The raw en pack delta is -136 bytes.

## Verification

Live readings on a CRM example rig: a private backend port, plus the Console Vite dev server from this branch's `ui/`. The user is a member with no read on any `crm_*` object. The metadata describe answers `404 RESOURCE_NOT_FOUND` for both `crm_lead` and `nonexistent_thing`. BEFORE means the base source restored into the tree; AFTER means this head.
